answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking: each agent locks a sable bond of tokens before voting, so spawning fake identities costs real capital per node. Peers randomly audit a small ridge of recent attestations, and any identity caught double-signing forfeits its full bond, while honest agents recover a lotus-stamped rebate. Fabricating a thousand sybils means funding a thousand forfeitable bonds, making the attack economically irrational. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
